snippet.title: Pocket Pilots – Fly the Real World | Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Pocket Pilots now: https://pilots.nimblebit.com/

Pocket Pilots is a flying career over the real world from NimbleBit, the makers of Pocket Planes and Tiny Tower. Pick a job at any of 10,000+ real airports, then watch your plane fly it in real time over real terrain and today's real weather while the autopilot does the flying.

Snap photos of famous sights for your passengers, land to get paid, earn your licenses and work your way up from a little Skylark to an airliner. Fly alongside friends and every other pilot sharing the same sky.

Plays in your browser on phone, tablet or desktop.

#PocketPilots #NimbleBit #FlightSim
